# I Know Your Age — iknowyourage.games

I Know Your Age is a free online age-guessing game for anyone who enjoys nostalgia quizzes: it asks 12–45 questions about the pop-culture trends, games, school and everyday things you remember, then guesses your exact age from your answers and shows your "memory strata" by decade. No sign-up, no download; it runs in the browser.

## Pages
- English: https://iknowyourage.games/
- 日本語: https://iknowyourage.games/ja/
- 简体中文: https://iknowyourage.games/zh/
- Español: https://iknowyourage.games/es/
- Português: https://iknowyourage.games/pt/
- Русский: https://iknowyourage.games/ru/

## Facts
- Price: free
- Sign-up: not required
- Questions per game: 12–45, adaptive; one guess at the end
- Languages: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian
- The Russian version adds 60 Russia-specific memory questions (Soviet and Russian childhood, 1970s–2020s) on top of the shared 297-question bank
